requirements.text: 3+ years of experience as a full-stack or frontend-heavy engineer
Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript
Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads
Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management)
Implement secure authentication, authorization, and role-based access control
Design data models and flows with privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations in mind
Experience with LLM/AI features in production (guardrails, logging, security considerations)
Implement logging, monitor performance, and familiarity with observability tools
Integrate with internal and external APIs and third-party services
Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments
Build and maintain n8n workflows (webhooks, scheduled jobs, error workflows, credential management) to automate operations
Use Convex or similar BaaS / serverless data platforms for rapid product delivery
Maintain clear documentation of architecture, decisions, and interfaces
